echo_capsule.name: Echo Capsule
echo_capsule.desc: Toss at a weakened wild Harmon to catch it.

great_capsule.name: Great Capsule
great_capsule.desc: A reinforced capsule with a better catch rate.

ultra_capsule.name: Ultra Capsule
ultra_capsule.desc: The finest capsule — highest catch rate.

repel_charm.name: Repel Charm
repel_charm.desc: Keeps wild Harmons away for about 100 steps.

power_band.name: Power Band
power_band.desc: A trophy band worn by keepers who prove their strength.

thunder_sigil.name: Thunder Sigil
thunder_sigil.desc: A storm-etched trophy from the Voltmarsh.

mind_sigil.name: Mind Sigil
mind_sigil.desc: A dream-carved trophy from Mirage Hollow.

chorus_shard.name: Chorus Shard
chorus_shard.desc: A fragment of the old Chorus — a story trophy.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.desc: Cast at water to fish up wild water Harmons.

revive_capsule.name: Revive Capsule
revive_capsule.desc: Revives a fainted Harmon with half its HP.

evo_capsule.name: Evo Capsule
evo_capsule.desc: Triggers evolution in a Harmon that is ready.
